CLINICAL DOCUMENTATION — NARRATIVE AMBULATORY PROGRESS NOTE V1
Patient: Sarah Martin | MRN: PAT-60019 | DOB: 1979-11-29 | Gender: Female | Doc ID: NARRATIVE_0019
Encounter Date: 2025-06-25 | Discharge/Note Date: 2025-06-28 | Provider: Dr. Emily Chen, MD
SUBJECTIVE INTERVAL HISTORY
SUBJECTIVE INTERVAL HISTORY: Patient Sarah Martin presents for longitudinal chronic disease management. Since the
last comprehensive visit three months ago, the patient reports adherence to diet and exercise recommendations. Recent
outpatient send-out interval laboratory check showed potassium of 4.01 mmol/L. Concurrent testing noted that fasting
calcium was 8.98 mg/dL. The patient denies any acute side effects or hypoglycemic episodes.
CLINICAL COURSE & PROGRESSION
CLINICAL COURSE & PROGRESSION: Over the preceding quarter, therapy with Azithromycin at 250 mg orally once daily
for 5 days was maintained. In-clinic point-of-care glucose was 88.2 mg/dL, confirming steady metabolic control. Vascular
and sensory examinations of bilateral feet were normal without neuropathy.
UPDATED CHRONIC MEDICATION PLAN
UPDATED CHRONIC MEDICATION PLAN: Refills were renewed for Metoprolol 100 mg orally twice daily, as well as
Amlodipine 2.5 mg PO every morning. Patient demonstrated proper technique and confirmed understanding of morning
versus evening administration.
FOLLOW-UP & COORDINATION
Return to clinic in six months for repeat comprehensive metabolic panel and lipid panel. Routine health maintenance
screenings were reviewed and scheduled.
